releaseNotes: new: Advanced Workbook Audit — honest workbook metrics (used-range, non-empty and formula cells), Critical severity, and new category filters for external links, defined names and security
new: Formula analysis now understands row roles — valid totals and subtotals are protected and never flagged as deviations
new: Possible Formula Replaced by Value detection — reported only with strong evidence, with a previewed before/after formula fix
new: Root-cause grouping — cascaded formula errors fold under ONE root cause (external source, broken name or broken reference) instead of one finding per cell
new: Review Fixes flow — preview each fix, uncheck what you do not want, apply with an automatic backup, then the audit re-runs to verify; Undo stays available
new: Safe broken-name removal — offered only when dependency analysis proves the name is unused; print areas and titles are never touched
new: New detectors — circular references, dates stored as text, and helper cells outside table areas (informational)
fix: The exported audit report can no longer turn formula evidence into live formulas, and reported finding counts always equal rendered rows (fixes the old 13-claimed/4-rendered report defect)
fix: Potential credentials are always shown masked — the raw value is never stored, logged or exported
